scope: Before/after shared explicit player/camera fixtures in production ExploreWalk at30Hz, day/standard quality, all30 pedestrian bodies and14cars enabled. All369 source points/native ground/trunk contracts; after native shared mesh bounds and per-ID transforms, four normal third-person screenshots with120 process-frame observations, real Input trunk contact/side walk/nearby E entry. NPC/car poses, collision layers and source trees are never assigned by this test. Headless native rendering is explicitly deferred. This is a narrow tree visual/physical regression, not a sustained FPS, botanical/survey, complete live-actor itinerary or human-handling claim.
